title: oxalis florida var. recurva
intro: Oxalis florida var. recurva, commonly known as the 'Purple Shamrock' or 'Lucky Clover', is a type of flowering plant in the wood sorrel family (Oxalidaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis florida var. recurva are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial agent, which can help to soothe and protect the body from harm. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its characteristic purple color.
